company.shortDescription: Bison Trails allows the user to run secure infrastructure on multiple blockchains.
company.description:
Bison Trails allows the user to run secure infrastructure on multiple blockchains.

The company's technology platform provides enterprise-grade security, multi-cloud and multi-region distribution, and a 99.99% uptime guarantee for node operators. Its aim is to strengthen the entire blockchain ecosystem, by providing a robust and secure infrastructure for the blockchain pioneers of tomorrow.
